items.name: Tarnished Blade
items.flavor_text: A worn sword, its edge dulled by countless small failures and small victories. Where every run starts.

items.name: Estus Charm
items.flavor_text: Doesn't refill anything -- just a reminder that the flask is always there for the next attempt.

items.name: Ring of the Bloody Wolf
items.flavor_text: Grants no bonus. Worn by those who keep coming back to the same fight.

items.name: Moonlight Greatsword Fragment
items.flavor_text: One shard of a legendary weapon. The rest, presumably, is still out there in the backlog.

items.name: Silver Pendant
items.flavor_text: Wards off nothing in particular. Looks good next to the bonfire.

items.name: Havel's Greatshield (Replica)
items.flavor_text: Absurdly heavy. Carrying it anyway is the point.

items.name: Crown of Dusk
items.flavor_text: Marks the wearer as someone who finishes what they start, most days.

items.name: Shard of the Elden Ring
items.flavor_text: Not the whole ring. Nobody has the whole ring. That's not really how any of this works.
